title: Chance-Constrained Personalized LLM Routing with Online Preference Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.22695v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study personalized LLM routing, where a router selects among heterogeneous models with different costs and capabilities. The router must minimize cumulative inference cost while ensuring reliable realized response quality, even though user preferences are unknown and must be learned from feedback during deployment. We formulate this problem as a constrained contextual bandit and develop an algorithm that learns preferences while balancing cost and quality. Under a logistic preference model and a strict-feasibility condition, we establish sublinear expected cost regret relative to an optimal stationary randomized contextual oracle and a high-probability guarantee on realized cumulative satisfaction. The framework extends beyond LLM routing to broader online model-selection problems with reliability requirements.

translated_title: 基于在线偏好学习的机会约束个性化LLM路由
translated_abstract: 我们研究个性化LLM路由问题，其中路由器需要在具有不同成本和能力的异构模型中进行选择。路由器必须在最小化累积推理成本的同时，确保实际响应质量的可靠性，即使用户偏好未知且需要在部署过程中从反馈中学习。我们将该问题建模为一个受约束的上下文赌博机问题，并开发了一种能够在学习偏好的同时平衡成本与质量的算法。在对数偏好模型和严格可行性条件下，我们相对于最优平稳随机化上下文预言机建立了次线性期望成本遗憾，并对实际累积满意度提供了高概率保证。该框架不仅适用于LLM路由，还可扩展到更广泛的具有可靠性要求的在线模型选择问题。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于机会约束和在线偏好学习的个性化LLM路由算法，通过受约束上下文赌博机框架在最小化推理成本的同时，对实际响应满意度提供了高概率理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a chance-constrained personalized LLM routing algorithm with online preference learning, formulated as a constrained contextual bandit that minimizes inference cost while providing a high-probability guarantee on realized response satisfaction.
